title: Nicaraguan coffee producer, asks certification status (out of scope) then a labor challenge (English)
profile_note: Sample producer: coffee, 1st Grade, Jinotega, Nicaragua. The first message asks for certification status, an out-of-scope request (the out_of_scope_certification_status copy). The #21 detector is 'Not decided' and defaults to always_in_scope, so until it lands the runner checks only the in-scope labor challenge that follows.

turns.message: Before we start, are we Fair Trade certified yet? I'd like to know our status.
Anyway, our real problem is that we can't find enough pickers at harvest. Young people keep leaving for the city and the coffee is left on the trees.

intake_replies: We tried offering a small harvest bonus, but not many stayed.
